_what: SUPER PETREL V4.2 (from the user's V4.1, 10 Nov), fitted to the user's three LS drawings (side / top / front, scaled to the maker's 6.35 m and 8.90 m): the top wing 0.30 m forward (wgDx -0.90 -> -0.60; the engine rides it); the rod 0.15 m longer (boomLen 2.20 -> 2.40) and more inclined (rodIncl 5 -> 8); the fin with a vertical trailing edge, its corners aft (finBaseZ -0.32, finAftZ -0.40, finTipZ -0.455, finSweep 19.5 -> 7) and lower (finHeight 1.1 -> 0.95); the stabiliser rectangular (stChordTip 0.85, stSweep 0, stChord 0.75 -> 0.6) and up a tad (stY 0.70); the cabin higher (roofY 0.68 -> 0.80, aft of the bubble aftRoofY 0.12 -> 0.22, bubH 0.79 -> 0.85) and the canopy flatter-topped (bubW 1.15, topRound 0.6 -> 0.4); the spinner shorter (cw_spinLen 0.44 -> 0.24); the nose tip 3 cm up (noseDroop 0.10 -> 0.06); the nose wheel 3 cm forward (s2Z 2.88); the lower wing higher (w2Dy 0.08) with less dihedral (6 -> 4 deg); the fuel where the type has it - the leading edges of the lower wings (wing2Root 46 L + wing2Panel 45 L) and a 4 L header behind the rear bulkhead, 95 L (the 912iS POH 25 US gal; the XP maintenance manual).  Not done: the tip planform (the leading edge rounded back, the trailing edge square: no tip type draws it), the boom as the type's tapered cone (ours a rod), the cowl closing onto the spinner. ROUND 2 (the user, 10 Nov, on the overlay): the rod's root 5 cm down where it meets the hull (rodY -0.10 -> -0.167) and 7.5 cm longer (boomLen 2.50) with the fin; the rudder straight (finAftZ = finBaseZ -0.32) and the fin's leading edge continuous (finTipZ -0.60); the engine 5 cm down (engBlockY -0.18 -> -0.247) with the body under the propeller lower (aftRoofY 0.15); the stabiliser's fixed chord 5 cm less with the elevator kept (stChord 0.556, stHinge 0.243), its outer leading-edge corners rounded (stSharpTip 3 -> 1) and 5 cm down (stY 0.633); the top wing's dihedral 0 / 2 -> 1.5 / 3.5 deg; the lower wing 2 cm higher (w2Dy 0.107) and AFT (w2Stagger -0.05 -> +0.38: its trailing edge ~0.2 m behind the top wing's, as the drawing). Empty 396 kg (maker 386), SM 17.6 %, design pass; 6.44 x 8.87 m.
